mapper.insert: INSERT INTO infra_file (id, tenant_id, biz_type, biz_id, original_name, file_name, file_ext, content_type, file_size, storage_type, bucket_name, object_key, file_url, md5, scan_status, scan_engine, scan_at, encrypted, sensitivity_level, user_id, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted, deleted_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{originalName}, #{fileName}, #{fileExt}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{storageType}, #{bucketName}, #{objectKey}, #{fileUrl}, #{md5}, #{scanStatus}, #{scanEngine}, #{scanAt}, #{encrypted}, #{sensitivityLevel}, #{userId}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{deleted}, #{deletedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE infra_file SET tenant_id = #{tenantId}, biz_type = #{bizType}, biz_id = #{bizId}, original_name = #{originalName}, file_name = #{fileName}, file_ext = #{fileExt}, content_type = #{contentType}, file_size = #{fileSize}, storage_type = #{storageType}, bucket_name = #{bucketName}, object_key = #{objectKey}, file_url = #{fileUrl}, md5 = #{md5}, scan_status = #{scanStatus}, scan_engine = #{scanEngine}, scan_at = #{scanAt}, encrypted = #{encrypted}, sensitivity_level = #{sensitivityLevel}, user_id = #{userId}, remark = #{remark}, created_by = #{createdBy}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, deleted = #{deleted}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE infra_file SET deleted = 1, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM infra_file WHERE deleted = 1 AND ( (deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at < #{before}) OR (deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at < #{before}) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(deleted_at, created_at) ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM infra_file f WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.biz_type IN ('excel-import', 'excel-export') AND f.created_at < #{before} AND ( f.biz_id IS NULL OR f.biz_id = '' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM infra_async_task t WHERE t.id = f.biz_id AND t.deleted = 0 ) ) ORDER BY f.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
